Name: Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Changes farmhouse map into an actual house layout with separate rooms and 2nd floor. Comes with bath pool, balcony and attic![/font][/size][/color][/center]

[url=https://postimg.cc/4n0m1Z1Y][size=3][img]https://i.postimg.cc/4n0m1Z1Y/tweaks-features.png[/img][/size][/url]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]New maps for all farmhouse upgrades![/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Decorate every bit of the wall your farmhouse have - long hallways for paintings and attic beams for banners![/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Second farmouse floor and attic! And it gets bigger witch each farmhouse upgrade! (extra floors are toggleable config option).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse Balcony - a tidy and cozy place which can be decorated and works as greenhouse: dig floor tiles, plant crops and grow trees in it! [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Catch carps in Balcony pond![/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Dynamic lightbeams in farmhouse and balcony![/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Extra fridge space - a hidden space below kitchen wall to place more fridges in. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Casks in farmhouse - enabled by default, allows you to play casks in main farmhouse map.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Everything is toggleable - config your farmhouse look as you wish![/b][/font][/size]

[url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Manual Recolor[/b] - None, Earthy Interiors, Elegant Town, Vibrant Pastoral, Rustic Country Town - Dark, Rustic Country Town - White, Starblue (1.6 unofficial).[/font][/size]

[b][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse Tweaks:[/font][/size][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Allow casks in farmhouse[/b] - Allows you to place casks in farmhouse.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Attic Floor [/b]- Adds visible ladder and warp to attic.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]2nd Floor [/b]- Adds access to 2nd farmhouse floor with door to balcony.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]Balcony Doors[/b] - Adds visible balcony doors - doesn't affect warp tiles to balcony, so you can place custom wall furniture and still warp to balcony map by interacting with wall.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Bathroom pool [/b]- Adds pool into bathroom - works like hot spring, restores energy.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Closet room wall and doorway [/b]- Adds separate room located in left side of farmhouse entry.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Floor Dividers[/b] - Adds floor dividers in between the rooms.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Wall borders[/b] - Adds wall borders in hall areas.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hidden area for fridges[/b] - Adds hidden space below kitchen bottom wall to place fridges in.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hidden double bed area [/b]- Adds hidden corner at the right wall of your kitchen to hide your first double bed for your spouse.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Remove Kitchen[/b] - Removes kitchen furniture tiles.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Kitchen Countertop[/b] - Removes kitchen countertop tiles (only for 2nd farmhouse upgrade.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Kitchen floor in Farmhouse - Starter[/b] -  Removes kitchen flooring tiles (only for Farmhouse - Starter).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]FarmHouse Lightbeams[/b] - Adds lightbeams to attic and farmhouse balcony doors during day and night (except rainy weather).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Balcony Lightbeams[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS]Balcony Config:[/font][/size][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Pond[/b] - Adds pond to balcony in which you can fish for carps.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Foliage Vines[/b] - Adds foliage vines on balcony walls.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hidden Sprinklers Space [/b]- Adds wall tiles on Front layer behind which you can hide sprinklers.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse remap toggle:[/font][/size][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse - Starter [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse - 1st upgrade [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse - 2nd upgrade[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#f9cb9c]IMPORTANT:[/color][/u][/b] Enable it only the day AFTER your farmhouse upgrade happened! Or else your game could crash while saving the night before the upgrade and you'll loose all your day progress.[/font][/size]

[url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Z0QCLZLR/compatibility.png[/img][/url]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Android compatibility[/b] - Should be compatible in 1.6 and Content Patcher 2.8.0 but not tested, can't quarrantie it will work. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Make sure to have the [b]latest version[/b] of my mod - compatibility on older versions isn't quarrantied.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Multiplayer[/b] - compatible starting from mod version 2.1.1.[/font][/size]

[b][size=3][color=#93c47d][font=Trebuchet MS]Compatible mods:[/font][/color][/size][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] and other mods  that don't change indoor  FarmHouse maps.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Mods that change the look of spouse rooms, such as [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/828]Spouse Rooms Redesigned[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12150]Asters Bathroom[/url].[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10029]Custom Spouse Rooms[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Cellar mods like [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9487]Hideaway Cellar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5664]Jen's Cozy Cellar[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17814]Tidy Cozy Cellar[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14521]Aimon's Fancy Cellar[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][size=3][color=#93c47d][font=Trebuchet MS]Supported recolors*:[/font][/color][/size][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Earthy Interiors[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Rustic Country Town[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Earthy Interiors[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Starblue Valley (1.6 unofficial)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Elegant Town[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]*[/b]All the rest of recolors will work just fine, but won't recolor farmhouse map tiles since I use custom tilesheets for farmhouse maps.
[b]*[/b]Recolors will apply automatically by default (if Manual Recolor option is set to None).[/font][/size][/spoiler]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Semi Compatible:[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Rommanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp[/url] - semi compatible (some events happen in farmhouse may be clipping through walls. Using Noclip Mode is highly recommended.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]With mods that add events in farmhouse, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] and [/font][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url] - events that happen in farmhouse may be clipping through walls. Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url] is highly recommended.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Other farmhouse mods - make sure to change configs for both my and other farmhouse mod in order it to work, or else there will be red SMAPI erros (both mods won't load). For example: toggle OFF  'Farmhouse - Starter' option in my mod; toggle ON starter house and OFF all the rest upgrades in other mod.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][u]Not compatible:[/u][/font][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120][font=Trebuchet MS]No Built In Kitchen [/font][/url][font=Trebuchet MS]- my mod adds config for removing the kitchen.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Other mods that change farmhouse maps.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/nMWC1Z1L/installation.png[/img][/url]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][font=Trebuchet MS]SMAPI [/font][/url][font=Trebuchet MS]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]I[size=3]nstall [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url] AND enable " [b]Non-Hardcoded Warps" in its config.[/b][/size][/font][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mod [/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] Unzip  "[CP] Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse"  archive into your Mods folder.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Enjoy![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/sXMHnJy1/bugs-troubleshooting.png[/img]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]First of all - [u]download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url] [/u]mod and [color=#f6b26b][u]enable " Non-Hardcoded Warps"[/u][/color] in it's config. There's some hardcoded stuff exist that this mod fixes. For example, it fixes wrong warps from balcony, fixes empty spouse rooms and cellar entrance disappearing.[/b][/font][/size]

[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]When starting a new save/ installing on already existing save,  furniture, bed and player will be stuck in walls. There's no fix to it right now.  Use  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mod [/url] which, after installing, can be toggled py pressing F11 button) to get out of the wall and relocate the furniture.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Same goes for deinstalling  - make sure to pickup all your furniture, chests, crops from farmhouse, attic and balcony maps; and store it outside the farmhouse map. Then save the day and remove my mod from Mods folder. After deinstall - you will spawn in black void. Use CJB Cheats Menu to warp to Farm and enter the farmhouse again, warps will be fixed. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Robin's Renovations won't work  - all the renovations are deleted by my mod, so do not buy them. For tweaking farmhouse, use config options my mod provides. I know this method lacks immersion but its easier to code and adjust on modder's side, please, understand. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Buggy Dining Room renovation tiles - if my mod installed on already existing file and you encounter messed up wall tiles in left corner of farmouse - remove Dining Room in Robin's renovationmenu, save your day progress and reload save file.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]DO NOT toggle on/off 1st and 2nd farmhouse upgrades the day before farmhouse upgrade. Enable it only the day AFTER house upgrade happened! Or else your game could crash while saving the night before the upgrade and you'll loose all your day progress.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Multiplayer Attic and 2nd floor warps - now should be fixed in 2.1.1 version (thanks to Farmhouse Fixes). [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Multiplayer Balcony warp bug - when warping to Balcony, you teleport to main (host's) balcony. This is unfixable - balcony is a custom location ouside of farmhouse map, it is only one copy of it, no matter how many players. So both you and host player will have the same balcony map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Spouse rooms don't have special NPC decor, such as Sebastian's Terrarium or Emily's Parrot - can't fix it for now. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Pets, children and spouses wander in void or stuck in walls / seem missing on some days - cannot fix it. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Make sure to place your first doulbe bed in main (1st) floor in farmhouse so spouses could sleep. Else there will be issues with pathfinding and spouses go unhappy about it.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Some walls are diagonal (higher than 3 tiles), there can be issues with uneven wallpaper patterns at their highest point. Better apply wallpapers that have plain colors for these places.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Buggy indoor farmhosue cutscenes/stucking in walls when cutscenes are happening (added by Happy Birthday, Immersive spouses and other such mods) - use  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mod[/url] during events ﻿to resolve this. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Bugged kitchen tiles when using "Industrial Kitchen and Interior" mod" - the way to fix it is going into Industrial kitchen mod config and enabling "Kitchen fix manual switch" option.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Trash can be catched in Balcony pond - cannot fix it, hardcoded.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/RqYNT9TN/credits.png[/img][/url]
